metricDefinitions.range: Minimum and maximum across peers in one run; not a repeat-sample confidence interval.
metricDefinitions.logicHz: Increase in maximum observed NextFrame within the fixed window; restored/repeated frames do not add new progress.
metricDefinitions.presentationHz: Game canvas default DRAW framebuffer color submissions; not GPU completion or monitor scanout.
metricDefinitions.callbackWall: Full native rAF callback wall, including history-only callbacks, production shell and lightweight callback hooks.
metricDefinitions.callbackBoundary: Include whole callback if it begins inside window, even when it ends outside; progress and holds stop at the fixed end.
metricDefinitions.observerWall: Post-callback snapshot reads timed separately; the observer is not claimed to have zero cost.
metricDefinitions.nativeReportedWall: onGameFrame-notified subset only; not a substitute for complete callback wall.
metricDefinitions.threshold: Every peer must have complete callback max, presentation hold max and frontier hold max <=100 ms, with valid observation.
metricDefinitions.memory: Observed simulation heap/journal usage and Wasm linear-memory capacity; not browser RSS or full-campaign peak.
metricDefinitions.saveCompletionObserved: First terminal poll observation, not exact native completion; includes 50 ms polling and possible scheduling lateness.
metricDefinitions.nativeValidation: Original production Runtime validation result; offline audit only recomputes actual bytes/hashes and event relationships.

autosaveCausalDiagnostic.finding: The old 30-second timer reached guarded score save with unconfirmed state; return 0 and empty error became fatal Error and loop_pause(1).
autosaveCausalDiagnostic.fix: Tokenized native save at a reconciled empty-history barrier; completion before Replay flush and real FS.syncfs acknowledgment; live input remains dispatchable.

independentFixedAudit.statusMeaning: Audit verification only; all original runner observation/save/performance flags remain unchanged. The independently normalized byte gate is a separately named result.

limitations: One fixed 15-second measurement per combination; no sustained 60 fps or complete-campaign claim.
Same-host multi-process SwiftShader observations do not characterize hardware GPUs, separate player devices, mobile or default automatic input-delay settings.
Different modes reach different gameplay frames; cross-mode ratios do not isolate rollback overhead.
Independent Replay prefix equality checks confirmed input, not full game-state or pixel equality; the earlier dedicated correctness acceptance is separate.
Sparse save observation reuses prior rollback statistics with rollbackObservedAt, not an exact-instant state snapshot.

A 2.94-second mode2-2p presentation hold overlaps a long ordinary-forward native callback, has no history-frame increment in that call, and precedes autosave; no profile establishes its internal cause.
The mode0-2p 1255.3 ms end-crossing callback and subsequent 395.3 ms observer are retained; measurement overhead is not assumed zero.
Original signedness-failed save receipt remains false; independent byte-normalized persistence evidence is separately named.
Console 404 records retained; their resource URLs and cause were not captured.
This report records the scoped production build, runtime observations and listed tests, not a rerun of every repository CI job.
